STEP 2 - Vessel size:
a) Square plates are typically 20-30 cm. This plate looks medium-large, about 25 cm per side.
b) Reference: the scrambled egg mound and the roasted potato/sausage-like pieces are roughly 2-3 cm across. The plate spans about 10 of those pieces across the width, which gives about 25 cm.
Both cues agree: width about 25 cm, area about 625 cm2.

- Mushrooms (whole, about 2.5-3 cm caps): I count 5 visible, and about 1 hidden under the pile, so 6. Each about 18 g, so 108 g.
- Carrot pieces (roasted, cut into chunks): about 4 visible pieces, about 12 g each. Estimate 50 g.
- Dark sausage or cooked item (the cylindrical piece on the right, next to the carrot): about 1 piece, about 35 g.

STEP 4 - Hidden food: No base layer is visible; the scrambled egg sits directly on the plate. Small pieces only, so no large hidden mass.

- Scrambled egg (with some butter/oil): 150 kcal/100 g
- Mushrooms, cooked: 30 kcal/100 g
- Carrot, roasted: 40 kcal/100 g

Totals: about 228 g. Energy: egg 165 kcal, mushrooms 32 kcal, carrot 20 kcal, sausage 98 kcal, total about 315 kcal.
